title: HotM Docs
tagline: House of the Memorian — the Fortémi desktop app.
description: Documentation for HotM: install, operate, and develop the first-party desktop client for Fortémi.

welcome.headline: Your Knowledge, On Your Desk
welcome.lead: HotM is the first-party desktop application for Fortémi — a React 19 SPA bundled with the matric-api sidecar as a single .deb / .msi / .dmg / .AppImage. No Docker, no Postgres setup, no backend ops.
pillars: Native desktop bundle for Linux, macOS, and Windows with a one-shot prereq script.
Bundled matric-api sidecar — same backend as Fortémi, kept in lockstep on features.
Editor, knowledge graph, capture, search, attachments — all running on your machine.
checklist: Run the platform prereq script (setup-linux.sh, setup-macos.sh, or prereq_once.ps1).
Install the latest HotM bundle from the releases page.
Launch HotM and verify the bundled API is reachable.
